objective: Guide a zero-authority host language model through activation and subsequent iKant_LE use while consuming existing owner-derived runtime/host materialization instead of reconstructing it.

trajectory.C46_C49: Separate cohost relation, runtime capability and canonical product; persist/reopen upgrade evidence and qualify exact merged bytes.
trajectory.C50: Native transcript identity requires external persistent participant/scheduler/delivery evidence and is orthogonal to runtime capability.
trajectory.C51_C53: Bootstrap, route, execution, same-session and native evidence are fail-closed and cross-bound; repository semantics cannot manufacture host facts.
trajectory.C54: The earliest honest host consumption surface is one validated authority-zero host frame containing exact shell/artifact/promise projections.
trajectory.C55: The host model is a zero-authority caller over one entrypoint; it cannot become planner, retry memory, evidence owner or NEXT owner.

challenged_c55_gaps: C55 terminates at runtime ownership but does not explicitly make the C54 validated host frame the sole post-handoff presentation envelope.
C55 does not explicitly govern later user turns and EXIT after bootstrap retirement.
C55 does not explicitly forbid fallback assistant prose when the host frame/route is unavailable.
C55 does not state artifact-before-shell ordering required by C54.
C55 does not explicitly declassify assistant-prefix/app/widget presentation from NATIVE_TRANSCRIPT_ACTOR.
C55 leaves the admission/I ACCEPT UX implicit in owner behavior rather than stating the caller-safe presentation rule.

ux_policy.pre_runtime: Present only owner-derived Terms/readiness/shell material; do not narrate synthetic progress.
ux_policy.acceptance: Only a later exact I ACCEPT provided by the human is acceptance; the caller neither infers nor repeats the gate.
ux_policy.runtime: Consume the validated host-materialization frame; do not reconstruct state from stdout, filenames, prior chat or documentation.
ux_policy.artifact_order: Required artifacts first, then exact owner-rendered ASCII shell.
ux_policy.shell: Exact bytes; no summarization, reframing, relabeling or silent omission.
ux_policy.frame_failure: No fallback assistant answer as iKant; remain at the observed integration impediment.
ux_policy.later_turns: Use the established runtime/host route for every iKant turn; do not reuse bootstrap directives as future authority.
ux_policy.exit: Pass exact EXIT IKANT through the owner route; do not self-deactivate from prose alone.
ux_policy.native_identity: Do not claim native transcript actor from labels, app/widget UI, cohost relation, full runtime, control ownership or product status.
